meta.name: Reptar Local Bus
meta.description: The FPGA end of the REPTAR board's local bus (Logisim-evolution ReptarLB): chip select, address latch, read / write strobes and the upper address bits come from the board's CPU, WAIT and IRQ go back, and the 16 address / data lines are three-state. Not simulated (the outputs stay undriven); for the FPGA flow on the REPTAR Spartan-6 board, VHDL / Verilog with Xilinx IOBUFs

hdl.unisim: the LocalBus module uses the Xilinx IOBUF primitive (UNISIM library), as in Logisim-evolution: it builds only for Xilinx parts (the REPTAR board's Spartan-6, ISE). Its bus pins are top-level ports; map them on the board's local bus.
hdl.insideIc: the Reptar Local Bus works only on the top-level circuit (its bus pins are FPGA pins); inside an IC its outputs are tied to 0.
hdl.insideIcComment: Reptar Local Bus inside an IC: no FPGA pins here, outputs tied to 0
